messages.text:
I’ve got the core option vocabulary now.

Next I’m checking concrete formatting from the official binary on a controlled tiny directory, because details like quoting, tree connectors, and long-column spacing matter more than broad docs for this benchmark.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'probe'; if(Test-Path "'$tmp){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp}; New-Item -ItemType Directory $tmp | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path $tmp '"'b.txt') -Value 'hello'; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'a') -Value 'x'; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'.hidden') -Value 'h'; New-Item -ItemType Directory (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'dir') | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'dir\\z') -Value 'z'; "'$cmds=@(@('"'--color=never','--icons=never',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-1',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-a','-1',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-T',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-l',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-l','--time-style=long-iso',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','--sort=size','-1',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','--sort=extension','-1',"'$tmp)); foreach($a in $cmds){"--- $($a -join '"' ')\"; & "'$ref @a; "status=$LASTEXITCODE"}'
